key_insight: Quantum computer rankings can change when execution fidelity is evaluated together with real cloud pricing, not fidelity alone.
engineering_relevance: For practitioners buying or selecting cloud QPUs, a cost-aware metric like Quantum Fidelity-per-Cost (QFC) helps compare backends under heterogeneous billing models.
method: Measured circuit-execution fidelity across 14 cloud access-path entries spanning 12 distinct physical QPUs.
Combined KL divergence from an ideal output distribution, shot count, and monetary cost into the QFC metric.
Analyzed ranking stability under metric reweighting and how scoring scales with provider billing rules.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cross-provider study over AWS, IBM Quantum Runtime, IQM Resonance, and OQC access paths, showing that cost-aware rankings can differ from fidelity-only rankings.
watch_item: QFC depends on provider pricing and billing policies, so scores can shift as machines are added or prices change.
paper_title: Quantum Fidelity-per-Cost: A Metric for Evaluation of Quantum Computing Systems
